booking.question: How do I book an apartment?
booking.answer:
To find an apartment, enter your dates, location and any filters you need. Pick an apartment from the search results and open its listing.

On the listing page, check the available dates in the calendar, the price and the minimum stay. If your dates are available, you can call the owner and arrange the booking directly with them.

Under MyBakuriani's current model, the final booking terms are agreed between you and the listing's author.

If you use Smart Match, you can describe what you need and receive matching offers. After that, you should still confirm the chosen apartment's availability and booking terms on its listing.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer:
Paid digital services on the MyBakuriani platform can be paid for with the online payment methods available on the platform.

When renting an apartment, the payment terms and method for the rent are agreed directly between you and the listing's author.

verifiedOwner.question: What is a verified owner?
verifiedOwner.answer:
A “verified owner” is a listing author whose identification details and proof of ownership or right of use have been checked by MyBakuriani under the platform's established rules.

Verification helps you make a more informed choice, but it is not a full legal guarantee of the property, the listing or any future transaction.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel a booking?
cancellation.answer:
Yes, but the cancellation terms depend on the conditions stated in the specific apartment's listing and on what you agree with the owner.

Before cancelling, please read the listing's cancellation terms and refund rules carefully.

becomeOwner.question: How do I post a listing?
becomeOwner.answer:
Register on MyBakuriani and create a new listing.

When posting, fill in the information the platform asks for, including the property type, location, price, availability, amenities, photos and other relevant details.

Before the listing is published, you may be asked to provide additional information or documents for verification, in line with the platform's rules.

The listing's author is responsible for the accuracy of the information in the listing and for having the right to offer it.

services.question: What services are available on the platform?

smartMatch.question: What is Smart Match?
smartMatch.answer:
Smart Match is a MyBakuriani feature that sends your request only to the listing authors it fits.

Describe what you need — for example, an apartment for 4, specific dates, your budget and a location near Didveli. The system compares these requirements with the listings' terms and sends your request only to authors whose offer matches them.

For example, if you are looking for an apartment for 4 near Didveli, your request will not go to an author whose apartment is in the centre or doesn't meet your requirements.

You no longer need to search through dozens of listings and call each one — you say what you need, and the matching listing authors receive your request and contact you themselves.

Smart Match — you say what you need. MyBakuriani finds who has the right offer.

responsibility.question: Who is responsible for the information in a listing?
responsibility.answer:
The listing's author is responsible for the accuracy of the information, price, availability, photos and other details in the listing.

MyBakuriani carries out moderation as provided by the platform's rules and, where applicable, verification.

However, verification of a listing does not mean MyBakuriani gives a full legal or financial guarantee of the listing, the property or the transaction.

availability.question: How do I know if an apartment is free on specific dates?
availability.answer: On the apartment's page you'll see an availability calendar showing free and booked days. Choose your check-in and check-out dates and check the minimum stay. To confirm final availability and booking terms, contact the listing's author.

support.question: How do I contact the support team?
support.answer: You can contact the support team through the contact channels listed on the MyBakuriani platform.

rateCard.principle: An ad is sold on a specific slot, period and share of voice (SOV). 25% SOV = about 25% of the slot's possible impressions; 50% = half; 100% = full exclusivity. Real impressions depend on the site's real traffic, so until traffic builds up we do not promise a fixed number.

rules.hero: 1160×180 Hero: at most 4 active ads; 25/50/100% SOV.
rules.catalog: 1160×180 catalog: at most 4 active ads; 25/50/100% SOV.
rules.promo: 320×180: at most 3–4 ads; one per page view.
rules.sidebar: 320×400: at most 3–4 ads; refresh no sooner than 30–45 s (the site uses 45 s).
rules.sponsored: Sponsored card: one in every 8–10 organic listings; at most 2 per page.
rules.mobile: Mobile: at most 2 ad placements in one screen flow; one ad's frequency cap — 3 impressions/day.

rateCard.example: If a slot gets 20,000 page views a month: 25% ≈ 5,000, 50% ≈ 10,000, 100% ≈ 20,000 impressions. This is an example, not a guaranteed minimum.
rateCard.reporting: Clients see their actual impressions, reach, clicks and CTR, the campaign period and planned vs actual share of voice — “Ad analytics”, the report of each ad.

apartments.title: How to choose an apartment or cottage in Bakuriani
apartments.p1: Bakuriani is a mountain resort in Samtskhe-Javakheti, about 1,700 m above sea level and roughly 180 km from Tbilisi. Apartments and cottages here are rented mostly in the ski season, which usually runs from December to March depending on snow, and again in summer.
apartments.p2: Listings on MyBakuriani are posted by their owners. Filter by dates, area, number of guests and price, open a listing to see its photos, free dates and price, and contact the owner directly. Prefer a hotel? Browse <hotels>hotels in Bakuriani</hotels>. Thinking of buying an apartment or land? See <sales>property for sale</sales>. For the resort's areas and how to get here, read the <guide>Bakuriani guide</guide>.
apartments.q1: How do I book an apartment in Bakuriani?
apartments.a1: Open a listing, check the free dates, price and minimum stay in its calendar, then contact the owner directly. You and the listing's owner agree the final booking terms between yourselves.
apartments.q2: Which area is best for skiing?
apartments.a2: Didveli is next to the slope and the gondola, Kokhta and Mitarbi are on the side of the newer lifts, and the centre has the restaurants and the park. 25-ianebi is considered a good place for beginners and families with children. More in the <guide>guide</guide>.
apartments.q3: Can I stay for just one night?
apartments.a3: Each owner sets the minimum stay, and it is shown on the listing page. If your dates do not fit, ask the owner directly.

hotels.title: Choosing a hotel in Bakuriani
hotels.p1: This page lists hotels and hotel-style accommodation in Bakuriani. Each listing shows photos, the price per night, the star rating when one is given, the location on the map, and a button to contact the hotel.
hotels.p2: In the ski season, which usually runs from December to March depending on snow, check dates with the hotel directly. If you would rather have a whole flat for a family or a group, see <apartments>apartments and cottages for daily rent</apartments>. For the resort's areas and how to get here, read the <guide>Bakuriani guide</guide>.
hotels.q1: How do I contact a hotel?
hotels.a1: Open the hotel's page and use the contact button. You agree the booking terms — dates, price and cancellation rules — directly with the hotel.

sales.q1: What kinds of property are for sale in Bakuriani?

sales.q2: What does the “verified owner” badge mean?

sales.q3: How do I contact a seller?

food.p2: You can also filter venues by area: Didveli, Kokhta, the centre or 25-ianebi. Looking for somewhere to stay? See <apartments>apartments and cottages for daily rent</apartments>, and for the journey from Tbilisi, <transport>transfers</transport>. food.q2: Can I see the menu in advance?

hub.lead: Bakuriani is a mountain resort in Samtskhe-Javakheti, in southern Georgia, at about 1,700 m above sea level. It is best known for skiing, but its forests, parks and botanical garden make it a destination all year round. This guide covers when to go, the resort's areas, the ski lifts, the road from Tbilisi, and where to stay, eat and spend the day.
hub.fromTbilisiValue: About 180 km by road, usually 2.5 to 3.5 hours
hub.seasonValue: Usually December to March, depending on snow
hub.winter: Winter is the ski season, usually December to March depending on snow. For 2025–2026 the Mountain Trails Agency (MTA) opened the Kokhta lifts on 20 December and announced phased openings at Didveli and Mitarbi from 27 December. Dates move with the snow, so check with the operator before you book.
hub.summer: In the warmer months the resort is a base for hiking, cycling tours, horseback and jeep tours, paragliding and other outdoor sports. The alpine botanical garden is a popular place to hike, and the parks are made for slower days.
hub.events: Bakuriani has hosted international competitions, including the 2023 FIS Freestyle Ski and Snowboarding World Championships.
hub.areasLead: MyBakuriani groups listings into four areas. Each has its own page with what to know and the apartments and cottages available there.
hub.skiingP1: The lifts run by the Mountain Trails Agency (MTA) are grouped into three zones: Didveli, Kokhta and Mitarbi. The highest lift, at Didveli, reaches 2,702 m. Travel guides report that one MTA ski pass works in all three zones. Crystal and the 25 Ski Park are privately operated and sell their own tickets.
hub.skiingP2: For the zones, the season and where to check opening dates, read the <skiLifts>full ski-lift guide</skiLifts>.
hub.gettingP1: Bakuriani is about 180 km from Tbilisi and about 30 km from Borjomi. Most visitors come by road: by car, by private transfer or taxi, or by minibus via Borjomi. <gettingThere>Read how to get to Bakuriani</gettingThere> for the options and what to check in winter.
hub.stayTitle: Where to stay, eat and what to do
hub.stayP1: Choose a place to stay among <apartments>apartments and cottages for daily rent</apartments> and <hotels>hotels</hotels>, or look at <sales>property for sale</sales> if you are thinking of buying. For meals see <food>restaurants and cafés</food>; for the days themselves, <entertainment>sports schools, equipment rental, snowmobiles, horses and other activities</entertainment>. A <transport>transfer or taxi</transport> and local <services>handymen and cleaning</services> are on the same platform, and the <blog>blog</blog> carries news and tips.
hub.q1: When does the ski season in Bakuriani start?
hub.a1: It usually starts in December and runs until March, depending on snow. For 2025–2026 the Kokhta lifts opened on 20 December. Check with the lift operator for the dates of the season you are travelling in.
hub.q2: How far is Bakuriani from Tbilisi?
hub.a2: About 180 km by road, usually 2.5 to 3.5 hours depending on traffic and weather. The road goes through Borjomi.
hub.q3: Which area is best for beginners?
hub.a3: <z25>25-ianebi</z25> suits beginners and children especially well. Compare it with <didveli>Didveli / Crystal</didveli> (close to the slopes) and <kokhta>Kokhta / Mitarbi</kokhta> (a premium area with new cable cars).
hub.q4: Is there a train to Bakuriani?
hub.a4: The historic narrow-gauge railway from Borjomi, known as the Kukushka, has been out of service for several years, and a full restoration has been announced. Check its current status before planning a trip around it.
hub.q5: What is there to do in Bakuriani in summer?
hub.a5: Hiking (the alpine botanical garden is a popular place for it), cycling tours, horseback and jeep tours, paragliding and other outdoor sports, and relaxed days in the parks.

gettingThere.lead: Bakuriani is about 180 km from Tbilisi and about 30 km from Borjomi. By road the journey usually takes 2.5 to 3.5 hours, depending on traffic and weather. There is no airport in Bakuriani, so the last leg is always by road.
gettingThere.carP1: The route from Tbilisi runs through Borjomi, and from there a mountain road climbs about 30 km to the resort. In winter, snow and ice can slow the last stretch, so winter tyres or chains are advisable, and it is worth checking the weather and the road before you leave. If you would rather not drive, drivers on MyBakuriani offer <transport>transfers from Tbilisi and from the airport, and taxis within Bakuriani</transport>.
gettingThere.busP1: Minibuses (marshrutkas) run from Tbilisi to Borjomi, and another goes on from Borjomi to Bakuriani. Timetables and fares change from season to season, so confirm the departure point and times with your accommodation or at the station, and allow extra time for the change in Borjomi.
gettingThere.trainP1: The 37 km narrow-gauge line between Borjomi and Bakuriani, known as the Kukushka, is part of the resort's history. It has been out of service for several years, and the government has announced a full restoration. Check its current status before planning a trip around it.
gettingThere.beforeP1: The road card on the MyBakuriani <home>home page</home> shows the estimated drive time from Tbilisi, and the maps on apartment, hotel and sale listings have a route button. Keep your host's contact details handy: they can tell you about snow, parking and the last stretch to the building.
gettingThere.q1: How long does it take to get from Tbilisi to Bakuriani?
gettingThere.a1: Usually 2.5 to 3.5 hours by road, depending on traffic and weather; longer in heavy snow.
gettingThere.q2: Can I get a transfer from Tbilisi airport?
gettingThere.a2: Yes. Open the <transport>transport section</transport> and choose “Airport transfer” in the Direction filter to see the drivers who work that route; you agree the price and time with the driver.
gettingThere.a3: Not at the moment: it has been out of service for several years and a full restoration has been announced. Check its status before you rely on it.
gettingThere.q4: What should I check before driving in winter?
gettingThere.a4: The weather forecast and road conditions, your tyres or chains, and your fuel before the mountain section. If you have no experience of snowy mountain roads, book a driver.

skiLifts.lead: Bakuriani's main lifts are run by the Mountain Trails Agency (MTA) in three zones: Didveli, Kokhta and Mitarbi. Two more ski areas, Crystal and the 25 Ski Park, are privately operated.
skiLifts.didveli: Didveli has a gondola, chairlifts and a platter lift, and its highest lift reaches 2,702 m above sea level.
skiLifts.kokhta: Kokhta is on Mount Kokhta, where the skiable terrain reaches 2,269 m. For the 2025–2026 season it was the first zone to open, on 20 December.
skiLifts.mitarbi: Mitarbi is the third MTA zone. For 2025–2026 its lifts were announced to open in phases from 27 December, together with Didveli.
skiLifts.crystal: Crystal is a privately operated ski area with its own chairlift and its own tickets, and the 25 Ski Park is likewise privately operated. Check what your ticket covers before you buy.
skiLifts.seasonP1: The ski season usually runs from December to March, depending on snow, and snowmaking is used at Didveli and Mitarbi. For 2025–2026 the MTA opened the Kokhta lifts on 20 December and announced phased openings at Didveli and Mitarbi from 27 December. The operator announces the dates of each coming season, and conditions change daily with snow and wind.
skiLifts.seasonP2: For current opening announcements, start from the website of the Mountain Trails Agency, <mta>mta.ski</mta>. Ticket prices and ski-pass rules change every season, so we do not list them here.
skiLifts.passP1: Travel guides report that one MTA ski pass works in all three MTA zones, so you can ski Didveli one day and Kokhta the next without buying again. Crystal and the 25 Ski Park sell their own tickets. Rules and prices change, so confirm with the operator.
skiLifts.beginnersP1: <z25>25-ianebi</z25> suits beginners and children especially well: travel guides describe the privately operated 25 Ski Park there as a short beginners' slope surrounded by ski-rental shops, instructors and children's rides. Sports schools and equipment rental are listed under <entertainment>entertainment</entertainment>.
skiLifts.stayTitle: Where to stay near the lifts
skiLifts.stayP1: <didveli>Didveli / Crystal</didveli> is close to the slopes, with cable car views; <kokhta>Kokhta / Mitarbi</kokhta> is a premium area with new cable cars; the <centri>centre</centri> has the restaurants and the park. Browse <apartments>apartments and cottages</apartments> or <hotels>hotels</hotels> by area.
skiLifts.q1: When do the Bakuriani lifts open?
skiLifts.a1: Usually in December. For 2025–2026 the Kokhta lifts opened on 20 December, with phased openings at Didveli and Mitarbi announced from 27 December. The operator announces each season's dates.
skiLifts.q2: Where can I check opening dates?
skiLifts.a2: Start from mta.ski, the website of the Mountain Trails Agency, which publishes the opening announcements. Conditions change daily with snow and wind.
skiLifts.q3: Do I need a separate ticket for each zone?
skiLifts.a3: Travel guides report that one MTA ski pass works in all three MTA zones. Crystal and the 25 Ski Park are privately operated and sell their own tickets, so ask before you buy.
skiLifts.q4: Where can I rent ski equipment or find a ski school?
skiLifts.a4: Under <entertainment>entertainment</entertainment>, the “Equipment” and “Sports school” categories list rentals and instructors.

didveli.p1: Didveli / Crystal is the part of Bakuriani described as close to the slopes, with cable car views. Didveli is one of the three zones run by the Mountain Trails Agency: it has a gondola, chairlifts and a platter lift, and its highest lift reaches 2,702 m above sea level.
didveli.p2: Crystal, which MyBakuriani groups into the same area, is a privately operated ski area with its own chairlift and its own tickets, so check what your ticket covers before you buy.
didveli.suitsP: Didveli / Crystal suits skiers who want to start the day close to the slopes and do not mind a short trip to the centre for restaurants and the park. If cafés and walks within reach matter more, compare it with the <centri>centre</centri>; for the other MTA zones with new cable cars, see <kokhta>Kokhta / Mitarbi</kokhta>.
didveli.listingsTitle: Apartments and cottages in Didveli / Crystal

centri.p1: The centre is where Bakuriani's restaurants, entertainment and central park are, and MyBakuriani describes the area in just those words. The Georgian National Tourism Administration lists restaurants, parks for relaxation, a cinema, snow scooters and an ice-skating rink among the resort's attractions.
centri.p2: The lifts are a short trip away, so skiers can still start the day on the slopes.
centri.suitsP: Stay in the centre if you want cafés, restaurants and evening walks close by, or if not everyone in your group skis. For the slopes, see <didveli>Didveli / Crystal</didveli> and <kokhta>Kokhta / Mitarbi</kokhta>.
centri.listingsTitle: Apartments and cottages in Centre / Park

kokhta.p1: Kokhta / Mitarbi is described on MyBakuriani as a premium area with new cable cars. Kokhta and Mitarbi are two of the three zones run by the Mountain Trails Agency; Kokhta is on Mount Kokhta, where the skiable terrain reaches 2,269 m.
kokhta.p2: For the 2025–2026 season the Kokhta lifts were the first in Bakuriani to open, on 20 December, with phased openings at Mitarbi and Didveli announced from 27 December. Travel guides report that one MTA ski pass covers all three zones.
kokhta.suitsP: Kokhta / Mitarbi suits guests who want the new cable cars close by. For the gondola and the other MTA zone, see <didveli>Didveli / Crystal</didveli>; for restaurants and the park, the <centri>centre</centri>.
kokhta.listingsTitle: Apartments and cottages in Kokhta / Mitarbi

25ianebi.p1: 25-ianebi suits beginner skiers and families with children especially well. It is home to the privately operated 25 Ski Park, which travel guides describe as a short beginners' slope surrounded by ski-rental shops, instructors and children's rides.
25ianebi.p2: Amirani Park, a forest recreation area good for walks, is close by.
25ianebi.suitsP: Choose 25-ianebi if you are just starting to ski or are travelling with children. For the MTA lifts, see <didveli>Didveli / Crystal</didveli> and <kokhta>Kokhta / Mitarbi</kokhta>; for restaurants and the park, the <centri>centre</centri>.

canned.schedule: All your jobs, from the platform and the ones you added yourself, are on "Schedule".
canned.readCvs: Applications to your jobs, with CVs, are on "CVs".
canned.reviewListings: New listings are on "Verifications", in the new listings tab: open one and approve or reject it.
canned.reviewOwnership: Ownership requests are in the ownership tab of "Verifications": check the documents and approve or reject. You can't decide your own request; another admin does.
canned.findUser: Search for users on "Users" with the search box.
canned.verifyOwnership: On "Ownership verification" pick your listings (rentals, hotels or sales), upload an ID card or passport and a Public Registry extract for each, then send them for review. Only admins see the files, and they are deleted after the decision.
canned.linkGoogle: On "Sign-in methods" press the Google button and choose your Google account.

canned.forgotPassword: On the sign-in page press the forgot-password link, enter your e-mail and we'll send you a link to set a new password. If it doesn't arrive, check the spam folder.
